content.text:
I haven't submitted the comps model. I only have sourced data for Cisco and one peer, Arista, and the brief requires 4 to 6 peers. My web search quota ran out partway through. Calls made after that returned "Server tool use limit exceeded", and a retry after a pause failed too. Filling the other peers from memory would break the rule against unsourced figures, and so would submitting a table with empty peer fields.

**What I verified (USD millions)**

| | Cisco (CSCO), FY2026, year ended 25 Jul 2026 | Arista (ANET), FY2025, year ended 31 Dec 2025 |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 63,325 | 9,006 |
| Operating income | 15,368 | 3,856 |
| D&A | 2,540 | not found (stockanalysis gives EBITDA directly) |
| EBITDA | 17,908 (15,368 + 2,540) | 3,929 |
| Net income | 13,267 | 3,511 |
| Total debt (excluding leases) | 29,533 (short-term 10,161 + long-term 19,372) | about 0 (stockanalysis lists total debt of only $90.5m, which looks like leases) |
| Cash and short-term investments | 15,918 (cash 7,218 + investments 8,700) | 10,743 |
| Net debt | 13,615 | −10,743 |
| Market cap | not retrieved | 215.79bn (stockanalysis.com/stocks/anet) |

**Sources**
- **Cisco:** the FY2026 earnings press release (investor.cisco.com and aol.com copy), the FY2026 10-K (csco-20260725.htm, accession 0000858877-26-000132), and a chartsview.co.uk summary for the debt split.
- **Arista:** stockanalysis.com income statement and balance sheet pages, which cite S&P Global Market Intelligence.

**Open issues**
- **Cisco operating income:** stockanalysis shows 16,086, but that figure excludes some items. I used 15,368 from stock-analysis-on.net, which matches the GAAP margin of 24.3% (15,368 / 63,325 = 24.3%). Please check it against the 10-K.
- **Cisco D&A:** the press release gives "depreciation, amortization and other" of 2,540. stockanalysis shows 2,563.
- **Cisco market cap:** I didn't retrieve it.
- **Arista debt:** please check it against the 10-K.
- **Fiscal years:** the data runs through mid-2026, so FY2026 is Cisco's last filed year. Each peer should use its own latest filed year.

**Peers still to source** (Juniper is excluded because HPE acquired it):
- Motorola Solutions (MSI)
- F5 (FFIV)
- Ciena (CIEN)
- Fortinet (FTNT)
- Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) as an optional sixth

For each I need revenue, operating income, D&A, net income, debt excluding leases, cash and short-term investments, and market cap, with sources.

If you re-run me with search available, or give me those filings or data pages, I can finish and submit the model.
